name: Language-native_name
label: Native Name
description: The language's own name in its own script, e.g. தமிழ் for Tamil, हिन्दी for Hindi — shown to end users instead of the English language_name.

name: Language-direction
label: Direction
description: Text direction — RTL for Arabic/Hebrew. Clients must read this rather than assuming every language is LTR.

name: Language-script
label: Script
description: Optional — the writing system's own name, e.g. 'Tamil', 'Devanagari', 'Arabic', for admin reference only. Not used by any code path.

name: Language-is_default
label: Is Default
description: At most one language may be flagged — enforced in truth_of_bible.language.enforce_single_default(). The site-wide fallback when a caller specifies no language at all.
